title: Small Group 2 Days Tour Icefield Lake Louise and Moraine
includes: Accommodation one night for 1 room per booking (Share room with 1 or 2 beds, max occupancy 4 people)
Personal expense, meal, and travel insurance (not included)
Gratuities (suggested CAD 15.00 per person per day) (not included)
Admission of Ice-explorer (Available to purchase) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 6 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel between 2 and 6 day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a 50% refund.
If you cancel within 2 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb:
*Guaranteed Departure every Monday & Thursday – exclusive VIP small-group experience with a dedicated guide!
*Explore 3 National Parks in-depth: Banff, Yoho & Jasper
*Exclusive Stay at David Thompson Resort, located in the heart of the Icefields – experience glacier stargazing & a complimentary nighttime visit to Abraham Lake! Nestled in the sacred solitude of the Rockies, the resort stands as a lone sentinel—a haven carved between jagged peaks and endless forest, where the air hums with the earth's untamed whisper. The Galaxy emerges in breathtaking clarity, a luminous river of stardust flowing between mountain silhouettes, so vivid you might reach up and trail your fingers through its cosmic current.
*Capture the best of the Rockies: Lake Louise, Moraine Lake, Peyto Lake, Emerald Lake, Bow Lake, Columbia Icefield, Natural Bridge & hidden gems!
*No shopping stops, no hidden fees! Enjoy an intimate small-group experience (max 14 guests) with ample time at each attraction.
